conditions: all frozen bidirectional VAE/global-embedding color perturbation arms from protocol/B_PROTOCOL_LOCK.json and its amendments
source_view: Tile 0 under the verified unique6 target order. Compare source RGB/condition/output with robust color distributions because the condition-only random geometry transform is not pixel registered to target RGB.

foreground_regions.robust_color_statistics: alpha/mask >= 0.75 eroded by 3 pixels; require at least 64 pixels

readouts: Per-view mean CIEDE2000 to GT over valid foreground pixels
Per-view signed mean and median Lab residuals (L*, a*, b*) to GT
Per-view median foreground L*, a*, b*, chroma C* and hue angle
Magenta-direction residual fraction: foreground fraction with output-minus-GT a* >= +5 and b* <= -5 Lab units; descriptive only, not a repair success endpoint
Per-view output color-shift vectors relative to paired GFL baseline and their direction consistency across the five non-reference views
Source condition versus source GT/output median Lab statistics; no pixelwise condition-to-target comparison
aggregation: Report source view separately; average the five unseen views equally per object. Do not pool pixels across objects.
image_identity: Every RGB path and SHA-256 is recorded in the corresponding results CSV. The original PNGs remain unchanged.
gt_usage: GT colors are evaluation-only. No repair parameter or condition embedding uses GT values.
forbidden: Changing color thresholds after inspecting generated RGB
Using input-to-target pixel alignment for the geometrically augmented condition
Using residual correlation as causal evidence
